name: app-store-compliance
description: Avoid common App Store and Google Play rejections. Open playbook and pre-submission guard with 125 documented rejection patterns and fixes, privacy manifest and Data safety checks, 117 tracked deadlines (EU AI Act, DSA, COPPA, age laws), and a skill for AI coding agents.
one_liner: A checklist-and-scanner tool that catches the most common reasons Apple and Google reject app submissions, before you waste a review cycle finding out the hard way.
buyer: An indie mobile app developer or small app agency that keeps losing days to App Store or Play Store rejections and resubmissions.
business_use_cases: A mobile app agency runs every client submission through it before uploading, selling 'guaranteed first-pass review' as a service feature.
A freelance consultant offers a paid pre-submission compliance audit for solo app developers about to launch.
A compliance-adjacent consultant bundles it with privacy-policy and age-law guidance for app clients in the EU.

money_ideas.idea: A one-off paid pre-submission compliance audit per app
A subscription that re-checks an app before every future release

steal_this: Offer five indie app developers a free compliance scan this week, then charge for the fixes it finds.
